description: This file defines a Canvas renderer class for vector layers in Leaflet, enabling vector graphics to be drawn on HTML5 canvas elements with event handling and rendering optimizations.

classes.name: Canvas
classes.description: A class extending Renderer that implements vector layer rendering using HTML5 Canvas API, with methods for managing drawing, event handling, and layer updates.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event bindings, including viewprereset event.

methods.name: _onViewPreReset
methods.description: Sets a flag to postpone path updates during view reset.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Initializes drawing and triggers initial rendering when added to map.

methods.name: _initContainer
methods.description: Creates and sets up the HTML canvas element and event listeners.

methods.name: _destroyContainer
methods.description: Removes the canvas element and cancels pending redraws.

methods.name: _updatePaths
methods.description: Updates all layer paths if not postponed, then triggers redraw.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates canvas size and transformation based on map bounds and zoom, preparing for drawing.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the renderer state and updates paths if needed.

methods.name: _initPath
methods.description: Initializes a layer path, updates dash array, and manages layer order.

methods.name: _addPath
methods.description: Requests redraw for a new layer path.

methods.name: _removePath
methods.description: Removes a layer path and requests redraw.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Extends redraw bounds and updates the specific layer.

methods.name: _updateStyle
methods.description: Updates dash array and requests redraw for a layer.

methods.name: _updateDashArray
methods.description: Parses and sets dash array options for a layer.

methods.name: _requestRedraw
methods.description: Schedules a redraw if map is present.

methods.name: _extendRedrawBounds
methods.description: Expands redraw bounds to include a layer's pixel bounds with padding.

methods.name: _redraw
methods.description: Performs the actual redraw: clears and draws layers within bounds.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears the canvas within redraw bounds or entire canvas.

methods.name: _draw
methods.description: Draws all layers within the current redraw bounds, applying clipping.

methods.name: _updatePoly
methods.description: Draws polygon layers on canvas.

methods.name: _updateCircle
methods.description: Draws circle layers on canvas.

methods.name: _fillStroke
methods.description: Applies fill and stroke styles to the current path.

methods.name: _onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, detecting which layer was clicked.

methods.name: _onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events for hover detection.

methods.name: _handleMouseOut
methods.description: Handles mouse leaving a layer.

methods.name: _handleMouseHover
methods.description: Detects hovered layer and manages hover events.

methods.name: _fireEvent
methods.description: Fires DOM events on layers.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Reorders layer to be on top.

methods.name: _bringToBack
methods.description: Reorders layer to be at the bottom.

methods.name: canvas
methods.description: Factory function to create a Canvas renderer if supported by browser.
